components.name: PieceSlot
components.usage: Right (dressing room). A hanger. Empty = still to find; Next = the piece being chosen on the left now; Filled = in the dressing room. “Change” on a filled hanger sends Quick Adjust chips to the chat so you can swap it or ask for something different.

components.name: TypicalWeather
components.usage: Right panel. What the weather is USUALLY like in that place at that time of year, from historical averages — explicitly not a live forecast. Drives the associate’s layering advice.

components.title: Paris, mid-October — usually
components.disclaimer: Based on past years, not a live forecast — I’ll check closer to the day.

components.usage: Right (dressing room footer). Adds everything on the rack to the bag in one tap: Partial while the look is incomplete, Default when all pieces are chosen, Added after tapping — the Bag Icon count goes up by the number of pieces.

components.name: ContextStrip
components.usage: Right (dressing room header). Two lifestyle photos of where the outfit is for; when a location was given, a mini map with the venue and the typical-weather summary sit beside them. Tapping either expands to the full Map Card / Typical Weather.

hostResponsibilities: Populate product facts and approved bundled product photographs
Supply historical weather with explicit source/disclaimer, never infer a live forecast
Provide a bundled Apple Maps snapshot if available; otherwise geometry remains an explicitly static design placeholder
Persist saved look selection, save/share/reset events
Handle cart quantity/removal/undo/checkout events; local preview updates do not confirm a backend order

interactionContracts.PieceSlot: Empty/Next have no mutation; Filled Change sends adjust_piece with category/product context for Quick Adjust
interactionContracts.AddToBagButton: Default/Partial dispatch explicit action; Added stays disabled until host supplies a new state
interactionContracts.BagPreview: Quantity is local mirrored data, 1–99. Minus at one removes and offers host restoreAction Undo; host dataset refresh reconciles local state. Checkout only dispatches a host handoff.
interactionContracts.SavedLooksRail: Selection styling is host selectedId; selecting sends lookId without faking persistence
interactionContracts.DeliveryEstimate: on_time=green, late=amber, unknown=muted, with semantic status text
interactionContracts.FitNotes: Size button asks host for choice; no invented next size
interactionContracts.DressingRoom: Legacy named fields retain Dressing room heading. Host slots preserve identity/order/product state. Black portrait width >=520 uses horizontal 240×96 cards; landscape uses two square-thumbnail columns; large text uses one accessible column. Selected black hanger tap exposes Change semantics.

knownAdaptations: 48px interaction targets and wrapping text replace fixed text-only click areas
Narrow panes and large text wrap contingency products, quantity controls, saved looks, and context strip
Saved Looks thumbnails center exact silhouettes rather than preserve incorrect overflowing coordinates in source
Unavailable weather Wind/Sunset icon frames are invisible in Figma and remain absent
Budget warning uses design amber token because note specifies warning behavior but no dedicated warning variant
At large text, Choosing now badge moves outside short white thumbnails to avoid clipping, preserving full text scale.
